messages:
elaine-cs: Heads-up — Heliotrope Dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final signoff on quota windows & autoscale guardrails.

mike-ops: Got it. Can you paste the quota numbers we'll claim?

elaine-cs: Customer will start with 120 reserved GPUs (g4dn equiv) across 3 zones. Target sustained qps 1,200 token-requests/min, burst to 3,600 for 10m. We requested 20% headroom.

sam-ml: For the model combo (redwood-7b + quant-lite) expect ~85ms p95 with continuous batching. Autoscale policy suggestion: 

sam-ml: ```
scale_up: >70% gpu_util for 60s => +10 nodes
scale_down: <30% gpu_util for 300s => -5 nodes
min_nodes: 6
max_nodes: 40
grace_period: 120s
```

rachel-se: QA will run a 4-hour soak from 10:00–14:00 PT. Test plan attached to the ticket: spike scripts + cold start loop. @toni-qa you'll own the soak?

toni-qa: Yep. I'll run spike script and validate fallback (model variant & region). Sharing load commands now.

toni-qa: ```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m spike.js --env TARGET=https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

mike-ops: Ops checklist: pre-warm KV cache, priming tokens (200 per model), deploy canaries on two zones, circuit-breaker at 5xx rate >2%.

elaine-cs: Also need KMS access confirmed; Heliotrope requires CMK in us-west-2. @rachel-se please confirm.

rachel-se: Confirmed — KMS key added and IAM role updated.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary 09:30 PT -> full 10:15 PT. CI checks passed.

sam-ml: One ask: add autoscale override boolean so we can lock at min_nodes during the first hour of production (to observe latency) — ops OK with that?

mike-ops: Fine. We'll expose `maintenance_lock` flag. Schedule note: after soak, release lock at 14:10 PT.

elaine-cs: Risks: renewal clause tied to 99.5% availability over first 30 days. If we see >1% 5xx we'll escalate. Keep logs for customer-facing report.

toni-qa: I'll capture trace samples and top-50 slow requests for post-mortem.

elaine-cs: Final: owners: Elaine (CS lead), Mike (Ops), Sam (ML), Toni (QA), Rachel (SE). Next sync 08:30 PT tomorrow in #customer-success — quick stand.

mike-ops: noted. I'll post runbook link after lunch: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/heliotrope-bringup

rachel-se: Quick question — do we enable per-token caching for embeddings? Might reduce cost during warmup.

sam-ml: Yes, enable prefix caching for repeated prompts, disable for ephemeral sessions. We'll toggle via `cache_profile=priming`.

elaine-cs: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
